title: “HE SHOULD HAVE QUIT ON THE STOOL!” Justin Gaethje SHUTS DOWN Ilia Topuria Rematch!
description:
Justin Gaethje is refusing an Ilia Topuria rematch after stopping him at UFC Freedom 250, and the fallout now includes Topuria’s glove-check comment, Gaethje’s response, and questions about whether the champion fights again.

Arman Tsarukyan is waiting after knocking out Mauricio Ruffy at UFC 331, Paddy Pimblett wants Topuria next, and analysts are split on whether Gaethje returns, retires, or takes the biggest offer available.

Credits: Flagrant Clips, One Night with Steiny, Kolos MMA, Michael Bisping, Daniel Cormier, The Ariel Helwani Show, Chael Sonnen.
